name: pilot-meeting-assistant-setup
title: 会议助理设置
description:
Deploy a meeting assistant system with 3 agents.
Use this skill when: 1. User wants to set up an automated meeting assistant system 2. User is configuring an agent as part of a meeting management workflow 3. User asks about automating meeting scheduling, notes, and action tracking
Do NOT use this skill when: - User wants to share a single file (use pilot-share instead) - User wants a one-off scheduled task (use pilot-cron instead)
